cat > slugify.py <<'EOF'
"""Turn a title into a lowercase, hyphen-separated URL slug."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    """Return a URL slug for ``title``.

    Accents are stripped, letters and digits are lowercased, and every run of
    other characters becomes a single hyphen. Leading and trailing hyphens are
    removed.

    >>> slugify("Hello, World!")
    'hello-world'
    """
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    ascii_text = normalized.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    lowered = ascii_text.lower()
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", lowered).strip("-")
EOF
cat > test_slugify.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

from slugify import slugify


class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_basic_title_becomes_hyphenated_lowercase(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")

    def test_punctuation_collapses_to_single_hyphen(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello,   World!!  Again"), "hello-world-again")

    def test_leading_and_trailing_punctuation_is_removed(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  --Hello World?!  "), "hello-world")

    def test_accents_are_stripped(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Crème Brûlée"), "creme-brulee")

    def test_digits_are_kept(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Top 10 Tips for 2026"), "top-10-tips-for-2026")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
EOF
python3 -m unittest -v test_slugify 2>&1; python3 -m doctest -v slugify.py 2>&1 | tail -3
